name: Look Elsewhere
author: Silouan Wright
description: A context-aware break coach built for Omarchy.

barWidget.description: Context-aware active-use breaks with native warnings and overlays.

defaults.breakSubtitle: Let your eyes settle on something distant. Breathe. The screen will still be here.

schema.label: Long break cadence
schema.description: Use a long break every Nth break. Set to 0 to disable long breaks.

schema.label: Enforcement
schema.description: Casual and Balanced permit bounded snoozing and skipping. Hardcore permits bounded snoozing, but the break cannot be skipped and ends only when its timer completes.

schema.label: Maximum smart delay (minutes)
schema.description: Start the break after this limit even when protected context continues.

schema.label: Break title
schema.description: Title shown on the full-screen break surface.

schema.label: Break subtitle
schema.defaultValue: Let your eyes settle on something distant. Breathe. The screen will still be here.
schema.description: Supporting text shown beneath the break title.

schema.label: Office hours end
schema.description: 24-hour time in HH:MM format. Overnight schedules are supported.

schema.label: Delay while the microphone is active
schema.description: Uses PipeWire stream state. Look Elsewhere never records audio.

schema.label: Reduce motion
schema.description: Show the break surface without animated movement or soft focus.

schema.label: Play break sounds
schema.description: Play a quiet cue when a break starts and a completion cue when it ends.

schema.label: Break sound volume
schema.description: Set Look Elsewhere break-cue volume independently of other applications.

schema.label: Custom break-start sound
schema.description: Absolute path or ~/ path to an audio file. Leave empty to use the bundled piano cue.

schema.label: Custom break-completion sound
schema.description: Absolute path or ~/ path to an audio file. Leave empty to use the bundled piano cue.

schema.label: Break outputs
schema.description: Show interruptions on every output or only the currently focused output.

schema.label: Bar display
schema.description: Show the eye, the compact countdown, or both. Vertical bars use the icon.

schema.label: Show keyboard hints by default
schema.description: Show shortcut badges whenever the panel opens. Toggle them temporarily with ?.
